protocol.json.optional_pk: Not eligible without full dated coverage and parity tests
protocol.json.selection: Four-fold logloss/Brier improvement plus Bonferroni 7-date block CI upper<0; one family at most
protocol.json.final_acceptance: Beats train prevalence and historical player rate on logloss/Brier; paired 95% logloss CI upper<0; ECE<=0.03
protocol.json.limitation: Same final dates previously used for POINT, not a completely untouched cross-task sample

benchmark_addendum.json.timing: After development baseline, before final opening or candidate selection
benchmark_addendum.json.reason: Raw historical rates can be 0/1; add stronger smoothed comparator
benchmark_addendum.json.final_gate: Also require lower logloss and Brier, paired logloss 95% CI upper<0 versus this comparator; no parameter search

pk_addendum.json.formula: 1 - sum(ppGoalsAgainst prior 10 team-season games)/sum(timesShorthanded prior 10 team-season games)
pk_addendum.json.join: Opponent; same season; strictly earlier NHL date; freshness <=30 days
pk_addendum.json.selection: Same four-fold gate and fixed family size 8 (5 initial families + PK + 2 complexity trials)
